sensitiveDiagnostics.description: Logs may include conversation content, model requests and responses, tool arguments, file paths, and interface events. Use for troubleshooting; logs are not uploaded automatically

diagnostics.description: Export recent logs, crash reports, and runtime information as a ZIP file; nothing is uploaded automatically

diagnostics.confirmStandard: The bundle may contain local paths, runtime details, and error information. Save it only to a trusted location and review it before sharing.
